'''Lanse Crowder''' was a criminal [[pirate]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Pabu" />

==History==
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|213}}</ref> Crowder made a deal with the [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]], received [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in exchange for an [[Unidentified artifact (Phee Genoa)|artifact]] he had procured. However, Crowder attempted to [[Death|kill]] Genoa afterwards, first trying to [[poison]] her and later releasing a [[kouhun]]. However, both attempts failed; with Genoa seeing through the poison drink and [[Hunter]] throwing his [[vibroknife]] at the kouhun, and after a [[Shootout at Club Lao Che|shootout]] between Crowder's henchmen and Genoa's muscle, [[Clone Force 99]], Genoa and her companions escaped. During the fight, Omega fires [[Omega's Zygerrian energy bow|her]] [[energy bow]] at Crowder and his men. She grabs the artifact and shoots down the hanging ceiling lamp over Crowder, leaving him trap as his henchmen chased after Genoa and her allies.<ref name="Pabu" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Crowder was a slick [[pirate]] who dealt in rare antiquities and other exotic finds. He was not above peddling knockoffs and poisoning his patrons if it meant he could sell a single item more than once and reap the profits.<ref name="Databank" />

Crowder wore a orange [[helmet]]. He also wielded a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="Pabu" />
